responsibility: Implements the x86 target builtin subsystem for GCC front ends and middle-end expansion. This file builds and caches the tree types and function types for x86 builtins, declares the large builtin set described by the generated type tables and i386-builtin.def metadata, validates and folds special builtins such as __builtin_cpu_is and __builtin_cpu_supports onto shared __cpu_model/__cpu_features variables, and owns the target-specific expansion and semantic handling needed to turn x86 intrinsic-style builtins into GIMPLE or RTL behavior.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-builtins.h, which declares builtin enums, descriptor tables, types, and public interfaces, this file provides the executable implementation of the x86 builtin subsystem: creating builtin types and declarations, folding CPU-query builtins, and expanding intrinsic-style builtins into GCC internal form.
